summary: RADCOM Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a July 30, 2026 press release announcing preliminary Q2 2026 revenue and revised full-year guidance. Management expects Q2 revenue of approximately $12 million, below prior expectations, due to customer deployment delays from higher component costs and supply constraints. Full-year 2026 revenue guidance was reduced to $57-$63 million (midpoint $60 million), with continued non-GAAP profitability expected. The company reports no cancellations or competitive losses, attributing delays to timing. No special-situation transaction, M&A activity, or corporate action is described; this is routine operational guidance disclosure.
